test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting in a straight line, facing north. Only five people sit between B and K. G sits to the immediate left of K. Only one person sits between G and E. D sits at some place to the left of F but at some place to the right of C.

Who sits third from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only five people sit between B and K.

2) G sits to the immediate left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/223e030ad50fef2024db640597b509f72b283c87a92c1e094fc1bf38fa92ed34.png] 

3) Only one person sits between G and E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/842b6460d522fb37c2cae88b09d1e8fd8c1692c9acb57bc44bea366e5b3aeb53.png] 

4) D sits at some place to the left of F but at some place to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1f6c765a564cebf354e41fbb5bdb430bf28d1433cda4299fb83a20873b12a60.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D sits third from the left end of the line.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
